compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: `CLAUDE.md` gains exactly one line in the Architecture (pointers) section: `- **Orphan-task convention** (DEFER rulings, lifecycle, validate-issues.sh exemption): \`docs/orphan-task-convention.md\`` — no inline expansion

## TDD Requirement
test-exempt: Unit exemption criterion 3 — static assets only / non-executable Markdown documentation file (CLAUDE.md is an LLM instruction file per behavioral-testing-standard.md Rule 5). The only valid assertion is structural: the line exists in the correct section, with no inline expansion.

## CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE Report

```
CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE:
Section: Architecture pointers
Gate 5 self-check:
  - Every-session: yes — orchestrators encounter DEFER rulings from the arbiter in every review cycle; the convention governs how they create orphan-task tickets consistently across all sessions.
  - Not duplicated: yes — no existing Architecture (pointers) entry covers orphan-task lifecycle, DEFER ruling behavior, or validate-issues.sh exemption.
  - Not enforceable as hook/skill: yes — this is a convention governing ticket creation choices made by the LLM orchestrator, not deterministic code behavior. A hook cannot enforce which tag an LLM chooses when creating a ticket.
  - ≤ 2 lines: yes — exactly one line.
Proposed line(s): - **Orphan-task convention** (DEFER rulings, lifecycle, validate-issues.sh exemption): `docs/orphan-task-convention.md`
Pointer target: docs/orphan-task-convention.md (created in Task 1)
Rationale (1 sentence): Future orchestrators must know to tag arbiter-deferred findings as `orphan:deferred_review` and that these tickets are exempt from validate-issues.sh health warnings — without this pointer, each sprint re-invents the pattern.
```

## Implementation Steps

1. Verify `docs/orphan-task-convention.md` exists (depends on Task 1).
2. Add EXACTLY ONE LINE to the Architecture (pointers) section of `CLAUDE.md`, after the existing entries in that section (before the `## Critical Rules` heading):
   ```
   - **Orphan-task convention** (DEFER rulings, lifecycle, validate-issues.sh exemption): `docs/orphan-task-convention.md`
   ```
3. Do NOT add any additional inline explanation in CLAUDE.md. All detail lives in the referenced doc.
4. Verify the line was added and no other lines in the Architecture (pointers) section were modified.
5. Emit the DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION in the completion report.

## DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION (to emit in completion report)
```
DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION:
Gate fired: 5
Target file: CLAUDE.md
CLAUDE.md edited directly: no — emitted CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE (the orchestrator applies after user approval; this task documents and executes the approved change)
Lines added to CLAUDE.md: 1
```

Note: The `CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE` report above was already produced during planning (implementation-plan Step 3). The orchestrator must surface this to the user for approval before this task is executed. This task applies the approved one-line change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/orphan-task-convention.md` exists (prerequisite)
  Verify: test -f "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/docs/orphan-task-convention.md"
- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` Architecture (pointers) section contains exactly the orphan-task convention pointer line
  Verify: grep -q "Orphan-task convention" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md"
- [ ] The pointer references `docs/orphan-task-convention.md`
  Verify: grep -q "docs/orphan-task-convention.md" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md"
- [ ] No additional inline expansion was added to CLAUDE.md for this topic (one line only)
  Verify: grep -c "orphan-task-convention" "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md" | grep -q "^1$"
- [ ] The pointer line is in the Architecture (pointers) section (between `## Architecture (pointers)` and `## Critical Rules`)
  Verify: awk '/## Architecture .pointers/{found=1} found && /Orphan-task convention/{print; exit} /## Critical Rules/{found=0}' "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/CLAUDE.md" | grep -q "Orphan-task convention"
